_comment_1: Enforced guardrail: blocks any tool call that creates a NEW Snowflake connection so the active Workspace session's auth token is always reused.
_comment_2: WHY: Workspaces provide a short-lived OAuth token (/snowflake/session/token). Creating a new connection (Session.builder, snowflake.connector.connect, etc.) opens a competing session that causes the platform to revoke the original token — breaking the Workspace mid-flight.
_comment_3: ACTIVATION: In a Workspace, copy this file to ~/.snowflake/cortex/hooks.json and set the command path to the absolute path of block-create-connection.sh in your workspace clone. The hook is automatically active for any Cortex Code session in this workspace.
